name: Thunderforest
tagline: Specialized OSM map tiles for outdoors, cycling, transport, and more
description: Thunderforest provides raster map tile services built on OpenStreetMap data, with styles including Outdoors, Cycle, Transport, Landscape, Pioneer, Mobile Atlas, and Neighbourhood. Developers request PNG tiles over HTTPS via standard XYZ tile URLs with an API key, for use in web maps, mobile apps, and GIS tools. A free developer plan includes a monthly tile quota; higher commercial plans are available.

auth.details: API key as `apikey` query parameter on tile URLs (e.g. `?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY`). Obtain free via account signup on thunderforest.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 150,000 tiles/month free (Hobby project plan); attribution required
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from ~$14/month with higher tile quotas; commercial licensing available — see pricing page

rate_limits: not published separately from monthly tile quotas

example.response_snippet:
HTTP 200 OK
Content-Type: image/png
(binary 256×256 PNG tile saved as tile.png)

use_cases: render outdoor hiking/trail basemap tiles in a web or mobile map
display cycling-oriented map tiles for bike route apps
show public transport map style for transit-focused UIs
add landscape or pioneer basemap tiles to a GIS viewer
swap OSM raster tile styles with an API key on standard XYZ URLs
